description:
Yokohama National University's Special Graduate Program in urban innovation and related engineering fields lets international students earn master's and doctoral degrees entirely in English, with MEXT-linked scholarship slots attached to the admission round. The application guideline, including the closing date, is published annually on the programme page.

Programme Highlights

  • All-English graduate education in urban innovation and engineering
  • MEXT scholarship routes integrated with admission
  • YNU's strength in infrastructure, disaster resilience and urban planning
  • Annual guideline with a defined closing date

Who Should Apply

Engineering, architecture and planning graduates targeting English-medium Japanese graduate study with funding.

Funding and Costs

MEXT-linked scholarship slots through the special programme: tuition waiver plus monthly stipend for selected candidates.

Deadline and How to Apply

Download the current application guideline from the programme page and follow its document list and closing date precisely. Key deadline information: Application guideline with the exact closing date is published annually on the programme page.
